fused form of tat and kṣaṇāt; indicates immediacy

items.question: What complete and immediate destructive effect follows from the prescribed practice?
premises: The object affected is all that is present or targeted.
The action described is total destruction.
The destruction occurs at that very moment without delay.
items.inference: Therefore the prescribed practice brings complete and instantaneous destruction.
items.plain_english: O Supreme Goddess, it indeed destroys all that in that very moment.
